summary: Describes using the HMAC construction with the MD5 hash as the authentication mechanism inside IPsec's ESP and AH. It gives the algorithm-specific details that the base IPsec documents leave out. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: A secret handshake proves a friend is really your friend. This document describes one kind of secret handshake, built from a scrambling recipe, that computers use to check packets are genuine.
